subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed in all contexts, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose runs, or should those detail paths remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface detail-mode exec warnings in several contexts, while this PR and its linked issue request a suppress-all policy; automation cannot choose that user-facing warning contract safely.

options.title: Clarify and test the policy
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail behavior first, then update the code and focused tests to match it before merge.

options.title: Preserve detail exceptions
options.body: Reject suppress-all behavior and narrow the issue to the specific handled-error warning leaks that should be suppressed.

options.title: Replace this branch
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if a broader exec-like normalization or recovered-warning PR is the better owner for the remaining behavior.

recommendation.title: Clarify and test the policy
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail behavior first, then update the code and focused tests to match it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and commit history place this handle closest to the current warning-policy and mutation-helper surfaces.
